title: LADA Turbo Kings vs Chill Vibes, Nov 1
notes: Home game at Snoqualmie A: we wore white and had the left bench; Chill Vibes wore navy with teal stripes. This recording had sound, and the referees' whistles pinned every penalty call.

Periods, goals and penalties come from the arena scoreboard (LADA TK was HOME), the game sheet and the video. The 1st and 2nd ran on a running clock, the 3rd on a stop clock. Goals at 16:05, 44:05 and 57:57 of the video, each checked by eye. The third came at 4:05 of the 3rd on the board's clock, where the board's score changed; the sheet has it at 4:56, when nothing happened, and the page follows the video. Shots on goal from the game sheet: LADA TK 28, CV 23.

Penalty kills, none of them scored on: a bench minor for too many players at 16:08 of the 1st, 3:00 served by Shakhov #78 (1:54 to 5:39 of the video); Kondratenko #12, tripping, 3:00 (7:30 to 11:07); Vasyliev #31, tripping with 1:47 left in the 2nd, 3:00, the rest served at the start of the 3rd after the board took 42 s off during the intermission; Unuchek #49, boarding 8 s into the 3rd, 2:00, so two of ours sat together for the first 2:05 of the period; Babkin #26, roughing at 2:14 of the 3rd. Chill Vibes had three minors, and the third goal came on the last of their kills.

Absent: Sokolov #4 and Podkorytov #82; the sub Kleiman #69 didn't play. Ivanov #90 played, though the game sheet doesn't mark him. Vasyliev's 1 has a long flag and reads as 37 at a glance; every white #37 was him.

Lineups checked by eye where the solver had the wrong count: 30 on/off spans, 2 of them by hand at the second goal (#89 on for #18 in a change on the fly). One change on the fly at 59:46-60:13 of the video (#78, #13 and #64 off, #61, #33 and #12 on) couldn't be timed to the second. The sheet credits Belov's goal unassisted; Babkin carried the puck in.

highlights.note: 1st period, 1:55 on the sheet (the clock ran through stoppages): Shakhov carried across the slot and fed Belousenko, who shot from the slot; the goalie dropped and the puck was poked over the line, 1-0
3rd period, clock 14:49: Babkin carried into the slot, Belov came along the goal line and jammed the puck in at the right post as the goalie dove across, 2-0; the sheet gives no assist

3rd period, clock 4:05, on the power play: a scramble at the crease with Belov and Babkin in front, the goalie down, 3-0; Tong's penalty ended with it. The sheet has it at 4:56; the board's clock stopped at 4:05 and the score changed 7 s later
1st period, clock 16:08: bench minor for too many players, the sixth skater over the boards; 3 minutes, served by Shakhov
1st period, clock 10:30 (9:56 on the sheet, the clock ran on to the faceoff): tripping beside our net; 3 minutes
2nd period, 1:47 left (0:58 on the sheet): tripping beside our net; 3 minutes, 2:03 of them carried into the 3rd, where he sat from the opening faceoff
